title: Joseph Kent’s CV
text:
Psychology and Data Science Student

joseph.e.kent03@gmail.com | LinkedIn




Student at Brigham Young University–Idaho pursuing Psychology and Data Science with interests in programming, research, and data-driven problem solving.




Python, R, SQL, Data Analysis, Statistical Modeling




Cognition, Decision-Making, AI, Behavioral Data Science




2021 - Present
Brigham Young University–Idaho, Rexburg, Idaho
Bachelor of Science: Psychology / Data Science
- 4.0 GPA
- Experiencing Research course
2017 - 2021
Eagle High School, Eagle, Idaho
High School Diploma, Honors
- 3.9 GPA
- Captain of Varsity Tennis Team
- Section Leader in Marching Band




Jan 2026 - Apr 2026
Research Assistant, Dr. Martin
- Led a student research team investigating doubling-back aversion and decision-making behavior
- Designed and conducted a 2x2 experimental study analyzing switching behavior and cognitive framing
- Analyzed data using R, including logistic regression and ANOVA
- Presented findings at R&CW (Research & Creative Works Conference)




May 2025 - Jul 2025
FSY Assistant Coordinator, U.S. Locations
- Managed program logistics and coordinated daily operations across multiple sessions
- Mentored over 80 counselors through leadership, training, and performance feedback
- Handled high-responsibility assignments including events, presentations, and technical setup
- Responded to incidents and ensured participant safety and program success
May 2024 - Aug 2024
FSY Counselor, U.S. Locations
- Taught daily lessons focused on personal development and goal setting
- Built strong interpersonal connections with youth participants
- Assisted in coordinating and executing daily activities




Jan 2022 - Mar 2024
Full-Time Missionary, South Korea
- Developed advanced Korean proficiency and taught daily lessons in Korean
- Led English Connect program and trained missionaries in teaching methods
- Created uplifting media content for mission-wide distribution
- Adapted to diverse environments including urban, rural, and military communities





Programming: Python, R, SQL

Data Analysis & Visualization

Statistical Modeling (Logistic Regression, ANOVA)

Leadership & Team Management

Korean Language (Advanced Proficiency)
